title: The internal scalar tensor square on complex representatives
statement: For every two internal R cochain complexes, applying the total left derived scalar extension to the localization tensorator and then the fixed scalar counit comparison and the ordinary signed total tensorator equals the internal derived scalar tensorator followed by the two scalar counit comparisons and the S localization tensorator. No K-flatness or flatness hypotheses are needed.

source.place: Tag 07A4, comparison with signed total-complex representatives; the counit characterization of the left derived tensor comparison.

proof.text: Apply coefficientScalarTensor_complexLocalization to the input complexes and their scalar extensions to identify the two localization tensorators.

The factorization property of the canonical leftDerivedFunctorIsoMapDerivedCategory identifies coefficientInternalScalarComplex with the left-derived-functor counit on the quotient complex. Substitute on the two factors and their total into the existing adopted-source theorem Functor.leftDerivedTensorComparison_app_app_comp_tensorHom. The homotopy scalar tensorator is the image of the signed total-complex tensorator. This is the required equation.

theorem coefficientScalarTensor_internalComplex (Z : Scheme.{u})
    (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleRingedComparison.internalModules R Z) ℤ) :
    let := internalScalarMonoidal a Z
    (internalScalarExtension a Z).map
        ((ModuleRingedComparison.internalLocalizationTensorMap R Z).app (P, Q)) ≫
      coefficientInternalScalarComplex a Z (P ⊗ Q) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (((Functor.OplaxMonoidal.mapHomologicalComplexδNatTrans (.up ℤ)
          (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a Z))).app P).app Q) =
    ((internalScalarTensorComparison a Z).app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)).app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
      (coefficientInternalScalarComplex a Z P ⊗ₘ coefficientInternalScalarComplex a Z Q) ≫
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ DerivedCategory.Q
        (((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a Z)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        (((Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap a Z)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
